nodes.label: Requirements — Personal Portfolio & Blog Site
nodes.rationale: Every requirement carries a stable ID and a pass/fail Verify line; success bar is qualitative by explicit decision, so verification is on the artifact rather than outcome metrics.

nodes.label: Goal: writing must stay cheap
nodes.rationale: Ceremony is what stops posts from happening; any requirement adding a publish step works against the goal.

nodes.label: Goal: nothing about the reader is collected or leaks
nodes.rationale: Analytics excluded; the no-third-party-request rule is the technical form of the same decision.

nodes.rationale: Q2 settled that v1 needs both a list page and a per-project write-up page.

nodes.label: FR4 — Site Structure
nodes.rationale: FR4.1 resolves the wireframe contradiction: About is its own page, since the approved scope names it a page.

nodes.label: FR5 — Discovery and Sharing
nodes.rationale: A feed is a static file collecting nothing, separating it from the excluded newsletter and analytics.
